semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end sensors and testing equipment specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Shanghai GND eTech Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and development, as well as manufacturing of high-precision sensors and testing equipment for the semiconductor sector. Their products, including fiber optic temperature sensors and endpoint detection sensors, are utilized by major integrated circuit manufacturers in China.
capabilities: CORELight fluorescent fiber optic temperature sensors
FIDIE wafer sensors for measuring multiple physical quantities

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and serves major integrated circuit manufacturers within the country.
